description: This file defines the 'PhotoDownloadRunnable' class, which implements a runnable task for downloading an image from a URL asynchronously, including handling network I/O, thread interruption, and state updates for a photo download operation. It also contains a nested interface for callback methods used by the task.

classes.name: PhotoDownloadRunnable
classes.description: A Runnable class that downloads image bytes from a specified URL, manages download states, and communicates with a callback interface.

methods.name: PhotoDownloadRunnable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the runnable with a reference to the callback interface implementation.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the download process: opens a connection, reads data into a buffer, handles interruptions, updates states, and manages resources.
